note: Optional model packs the desktop installer carries, so they work with no download. scripts/build-desktop.mjs fetches each file into public/models/ from <host>/<sha256>/<file>, checked against this size and SHA-256 (the same pins as src/core/optionalModels.ts). A pack whose files cannot all be fetched is left out of that installer and stays a download. RED packs (EfficientSAM-Ti tap to select, BiRefNet_lite fine edges) are out of the default installer under the model licence policy of 28 Nov 2026; they are not listed here.
